scope: Descriptive diagnostic using two fixed predeclared visualQA cases. No threshold sweep, fit, calibration or model/architecture/data selection.
decoder: rawscore>=t E, rawscore<t D; actualprospective t remains0
proof: To correct visiblecase D requires t>visible_score; to correct externalcase E requires t<=external_score. visible_score>external_score, so no single monotone scalar threshold can correct BOTH these fixed examples.
claim_limit: This does not quantify population prevalence or isolate syntheticweaklabel target mismatch, appearance transfer, SAM or shared encoder effects. ExistinghumanD/E authority retained, no new labels or thresholds.
